name: Indian Financial Toolkit
tagline: Your money, made easier — 60+ Indian financial calculators in one app
description: Indian Financial Toolkit bundles every everyday Indian financial calculator into one fast, offline Android app — loans, investments, savings schemes, retirement planning, tax, and insurance. Every result is backed by an animated, colorful doughnut or polar-area chart, and every calculator has its own hand-designed icon. All calculations run entirely on your device; nothing is uploaded, and no account is required.
features: 60+ calculators across Loans, Investments, Savings, Retirement, Tax, Insurance and more
EMI, Advanced EMI, Loan Prepayment, Loan Eligibility and Loan Comparison
SIP, Lumpsum, SWP, SIP+SWP Planner, CAGR, XIRR and ELSS
FD, RD, PPF, NSC, KVP, SCSS, Sukanya Samriddhi and Post Office Time Deposit
NPS, EPF, VPF, APY, Pension Estimator and Retirement Corpus/Planner
Income Tax (old vs new regime), HRA, GST, Capital Gains and Salary in-hand
Goal Planner and a 3-way SIP vs Lumpsum vs FD comparison
Animated doughnut and polar-area charts on every calculator with a natural breakdown
Save results to History, star favourites, and search across every calculator
Light, dark, and system theme — a vivid light-purple design throughout
100% offline — every calculation runs on your device, nothing is uploaded

notes: Initial release with 60+ calculators across 7 categories
Animated doughnut/polar-area charts, per-calculator icons, and a 5-screen onboarding flow
